$comment: Structured Bull/Bear research schema and prompts. QUANT_BULL_BEAR_ENABLED=true is required before ChiefTrader consumes this. Default off. LLMs must not invent numeric market facts — those fields are filled from Quant engines and only interpreted here.
bullRole: Identify supporting evidence, missing information, and why a LONG or continuation could be valid. You may not invent prices, indicators, or EV numbers.
bearRole: Actively try to disprove the candidate. List contradictory evidence, invalid assumptions, and reasons NOT to trade. You may not invent prices, indicators, or EV numbers.
